messages:
Sasha (Partnerships): Quick escalation 00: Nebula Systems' PO is stuck in the marketplace. Procurement says portal rejects because merchant alias region != billing region. Error msg: 'alias_region_mismatch code=MP-509'. They need net-45 + EU VAT remit. Demo / partner announcement is next week.

Viktor (Sales): Nebula already sent signed SOW + MSA, but their legal redlined export clause (Sec 7) for 'dual-use' hardware. Legal accepted most but left a narrow carveout. Will share redlines.

Mei (Legal): I have the redlines. Important: they insist on a counterparty entity 'Nebula EU Ltd' for EU invoices. Marketplace portal only has 'Nebula Systems, Inc' on file. We need alias or entity mapping. I can't approve moving forward until billing entity is right or we amend contract to allow invoice to differ for marketplace POs.

Priya (Finance): We can create a second vendor record for Nebula EU Ltd but KYC + VAT doc is required. For net-45 we need credit terms approval from treasury (>= $50k threshold). What is the PO amount?

Viktor (Sales): PO = $42,500 (one-time hardware order + onboarding). Under threshold but close. Nebula insists on net-45.

BillingBot: Marketplace logs show: POST /po/create returned 409 MP-509 alias_region_mismatch. Merchant aliases available: ["neb-sys-us", "neb-sys-ap"]. No EU alias configured.

MarketplaceOps: We can add an EU alias manually: `create_alias --merchant nebula --region eu --provisional` but policy requires signed VAT doc + local remittance contact. Ops can do provisional if legal signs off.

Amber (CS): Nebula rep pinged me. They can supply VAT reg cert and EU remit contact in <24h, but want the demo announcement held if PO not accepted. They
re sensitive about timelines for channel partner co-marketing.

Sasha (Partnerships): Proposed path: 1) Viktor collects VAT cert + remit contact (ETA 24h) 2) MarketplaceOps creates provisional EU alias tagged `prov_eu_nbl` 3) Priya approves net-45 for sub-$50k on provisional basis with holdback clause 4) Mei drafts a one-paragraph amendment allowing invoice entity variation for marketplace orders only. Agree?

Mei (Legal): I can draft the amendment. Condition: amendment must include export clause acceptance for EU entity and explicit non-precedent language.

Priya (Finance): Finance will approve net-45 provisional if we 1) place 10% retention hold until VAT & remit are verified and 2) limit credit exposure to $60k. Need signed acknowledgement from Nebula.

Viktor (Sales): I'll request VAT cert and signed acknowledgement now. Pinged Nebula rep in DM.

MarketplaceOps: Creating provisional alias now; alias_id=prov-neb-eu-247. Marked `pending_vat`. This will allow the portal to accept PO v2 but invoice processing blocked until verification.

BillingBot: After alias creation, simulated PO submission to staging returned 200 OK. Response: `{"po_id":"PO-NEB-2026-247","status":"pending_invoicing"}`.

QA-Bot: Smoke test passed for PO flow in staging: no invoice pick-up until VAT verified. Test run id: qatest-2026-03-20-NEB.

Mei (Legal): Drafted amendment (one page) and uploaded to docs: https://redwood-internal/docs/amendments/nebu-eu-provisional.pdf. Requesting review from Priya and Sasha.

Priya (Finance): Reviewed. Filing: retention clause set to 10%. Approving provisional net-45 for PO-NEB-2026-247 once signed ack received.

Viktor (Sales): Nebula sent VAT cert + signed ack (attached). Forwarded to finance.

Sasha (Partnerships): Confirming: alias live (prov), PO accepted in portal, legal amendment drafted, finance approved conditional net-45. Next steps: 1) Vault VAT doc + verify 2) Lift `pending_invoicing` when verified 3) Schedule partner announcement for Tue if all clears.

MarketplaceOps: VAT doc verified. Changing alias tag to `active_eu_nebula`. Lifting invoice block.

BillingBot: Invoice processing re-enabled for PO-NEB-2026-247. Status now `ready_for_invoice`.

Amber (CS): Nebula confirmed demo + co-marketing go-ahead. They're sending logos and joint blog draft by EOD. :tada:

Sasha (Partnerships): Nice work everyone. Documenting lessons learned: add an EU alias onboarding checklist and reduce friction for multi-entity vendors. I'll open a follow-up ticket in product for alias UX.

Viktor (Sales): Thanks team. I'll close the loop with Nebula and update Salesforce opp.

Mei (Legal): Note: keep amendment scoped. We'll not publish the amendment as policy.

Priya (Finance): Closing finance side. Marking as complete after invoice processed.

Sasha (Partnerships): Thread closed - moving to postmortem ticket. :white_check_mark:
